timer.name: autoclosevideoosd
timer.description: Timer to auto close the video OSD (if enabled in the skin settings)

timer.name: 1109_topbaroverlay
timer.description: A timer that is activated when the topbaroverlay is loaded and stops automatically after 5 seconds (or playback is resumed)

timer.name: lumenpersonplay
timer.description: A video started from the actor page (a title opened on it, or a poster's Play or menu): Kodi won't go full screen while a modal dialog is open, so close the actor page and the detail page below it, then go. Not the video that was already playing when the page opened

timer.name: lumenkidsperson
timer.description: No actor page in kids mode: one open when kids mode comes on (or opened in it) closes with the detail page below it, then Home (Kodi won't change window while a modal dialog is open)

timer.name: lumenkidslivetv
timer.description: No live TV in kids mode (nothing filters channels for children): a channel, radio station or recording started while it's on (from a phone app, say), or playing when it comes on, stops

timer.name: lumenmoreopen
timer.description: A film picked in a More like this row (Custom_1116_LumenOpen.xml): once its one-film list has loaded, Info on it opens its detail page like from any grid; then the helper goes, so Back leaves the page for where it was opened from

timer.name: lumenmoreopenfail
timer.description: The film picked in a More like this row didn't load (gone from the library, or the database didn't answer): after 10 seconds the helper closes rather than leave its backdrop on screen
